# Telos Group

> Telos Group (telosgroup.co.uk) sends small UK trades firms a Monday email listing public tenders that fit their trade, their area and the size of job they go for, plus contracts near them that are ending soon.

## Who we are

Telos Group is a small business run by Marcus Mangoro. Its tagline is "Finding your work in the noise". We are already helping <!--gen:firm_count-->40+<!--/gen:firm_count--> firms across waste and recycling, cleaning, grounds, tree surgery and building maintenance.

## The Monday email

The email arrives every Monday morning. Firms can ask for it daily or monthly instead. Each email lists the open tenders that best match the firm, with the real deadline and a link to each one. For two-stage tenders it shows the first deadline, the request to take part. It also includes:

- Coming up: a contract near the firm whose current term ends in the next <!--gen:window_months-->18<!--/gen:window_months--> months, and who holds it now.
- Closing soon: a reminder of matching tenders that close in the next 10 days.

Every new notice is checked against the firm's trade, how far it will travel and its usual contract size, then scored for fit. AI reads each notice to weed out ones that only look relevant. Marcus checks every list before it is sent. Firms reply to say what is useful, and the list changes to match.

## Trades and areas

Trades: commercial and specialist cleaning, washroom hygiene, grounds maintenance, tree surgery, gritting and hedge cutting, skip hire and waste collection, scrap metal and recycling, void and house clearances, gas and heating servicing, and building repairs and maintenance.

Areas: anywhere in the UK. Tenders come from the official UK tender portals, and we use other public records of what public bodies buy to see when existing contracts end. Some smaller tenders in Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are only advertised locally and may not reach us yet.

## Most small contracts were not advertised on Find a Tender

We looked at 1,427 contracts awarded in these trades from January to October 2026. Of the 659 worth under £140k, about 8 in 10 had no tender notice on Find a Tender. They only showed up once the work had been awarded.

Source: Telos Group analysis of Find a Tender award and tender notices, January to October 2026. Some of these contracts may have been advertised elsewhere, so treat the figure as an estimate. Under £140k means below the central government services threshold of £139,688.

## How a firm asks to be added

Email mangoro@telosgroup.co.uk with your trade and the area you cover. Marcus replies himself.
